question: 单项选择：We had a party _____ last month. A. ago  B. last  C. yesterday  D. since
answer: 答案：B. last。解析：last + 时间单位（last month上月）是过去时常用时间状语。

question: 单项选择：I saw him _____ morning. A. tomorrow  B. yesterday  C. next  D. every
answer: 答案：B. yesterday。解析：yesterday morning（昨天上午）是一般过去时的时间状语。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：They ______ (go) to the cinema three days ______ (ago).
answer: 答案：went, ago。解析：three days ago（三天前）是一般过去时。go是不规则动词，过去式是went。

question: 单项选择：She visited her uncle _____ last summer. A. ago  B. the day before yesterday  C. last  D. just now
answer: 答案：C. last。解析：last summer（去年夏天）是一般过去时时间状语。

question: 单项选择：He was born _____ 2010. A. ago  B. last  C. in  D. since
answer: 答案：C. in。解析：in + 年份表示在某一年，出生在过去某一年用一般过去时。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：It ______ (snow) heavily last night.
answer: 答案：snowed。解析：last night（昨晚）是一般过去时。snow是规则动词，加-ed变snowed。

question: 单项选择：My family moved to Beijing _____. A. last year  B. tomorrow  C. next week  D. now
answer: 答案：A. last year。解析：last year（去年）是一般过去时。

question: 单项选择：I met your brother _____ the day before yesterday. A. last  B. the day  C. in  D. on
answer: 答案：B. the day。解析：the day before yesterday（前天）是一般过去时时间状语。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：She ______ (be) very busy last week.
answer: 答案：was。解析：last week是一般过去时。主语she是第三人称单数，be动词用was。

question: 单项选择：My grandfather _____ us a lot of stories when I was a child. A. tells  B. told  C. is telling  D. will tell
answer: 答案：B. told。解析：when I was a child是一般过去时。
